questions.q: In 'The Bat and the Weasels', what did the Bat tell the first Weasel, who hated Mice?
choices: That he was a Bird
That he was a Mouse
That he was a Cat
That he was a Weasel too

questions.q: In 'The Bat and the Weasels', how did the Bat prove to the second Weasel that he was not a Bird?
choices: He said all Birds have feathers and he had none
He showed his leathery wings to the Weasel
He sang a sweet song like a little bird
He ate some cheese the way a Mouse would

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Bat and the Weasels'?
choices: Set your sails with the wind
Never tell a lie to anyone
Stay away from birds' nests
Birds and mice should be friends
questions.evidence: Set your sails with the wind.

questions.q: In 'The Quack Toad', why did the Fox not believe the Toad could cure anything?
choices: The Toad could not even cure his own blotchy skin
The Toad had no medicine at all in his little bag
The Toad was far too young to be a doctor
The Fox was a well-known doctor himself
questions.evidence: If you can cure yourself of that blotchy skin and that rheumatic gait

questions.q: In 'The Fox Without a Tail', how did the Fox lose his tail?
choices: It was caught in a trap
Hounds bit it off in a chase
A hunter cut it off with a knife
It got stuck in a thorny hedge
questions.evidence: A Fox that had been caught in a trap

questions.q: In 'The Fox Without a Tail', why did the Fox tell the other Foxes to cut off their tails?
choices: So they would look like him and not laugh at him
Because long tails make all Foxes sick in winter
Because men will pay a high price for fox tails
Because tails get dirty and full of burrs
questions.evidence: Do not listen to the advice of him who seeks to lower you to his own level.

questions.q: In 'The Mischievous Dog', the moral says 'Notoriety is not fame.' What does notoriety mean here?
choices: Being known for something bad
Being loved by everyone in town
Being very quiet and well behaved
Being the fastest dog in the yard

questions.q: In 'The Rose and the Butterfly', what lesson does the Butterfly teach the Rose?
choices: Do not expect faithfulness if you are not faithful
Flowers should never trust the bees in the garden
Butterflies should stay home with one flower only
Always be kind to the little bugs in the garden
questions.evidence: Do not expect constancy in others if you have none yourself.
